blocks.tamil_translation: I said. “Control your tongue,” the Prophet ﷺ said. “If my tongue is not under my control, what else could be under my control?” I said. “Do not use your hand for anything except good deeds, and say only good words with your tongue!” the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَسْلَمَ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ اَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ اِطَّلَعَ عَلي اَبِيْ بَكْرٍ وَهُوَ يَمُدُّ لِسَانَهُ قَالَ: مَا تَصْنَعُ يَا خَلِيْفَةَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ؟ قَالَ:اِنَّ هذَا الَّذِيْ اَوْرَدَ نِيَ الْمَوَارِدَ،اِنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْجَسَدِ اِلَّا يَشْكُوْ ذَرَبَ اللِّسَانِ عَلي حِدَّتِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aslam (RH) says, Hazrat Umar (RA) saw Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) pulling at his tongue and asked, “O Khalifah of the Messenger of Allah, what are you doing?” “This tongue is what has taken me to places of ruin,” he said, and then Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) said that the Prophet ﷺ said, “There is no part of the body that does not complain about the harm of the tongue caused by evil words and the sharpness of the tongue.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: كُنْتُ رَجُلاً ذَرِبَ اللِّسَانِ عَلي اَهْلِيْ فَقُلْتُ:يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ قَدْ خَشِيْتُ اَنْ يُدْخِلَنِيْ لِسَانِيَ النَّارَ قَالَ: فَاَيْنَ اَنْتَ مِنَ اْلاِسْتِغْفَارِ؟ اِنِّيْ لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةً.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Hudhaifah (RA) says, “I used to use my tongue excessively against my household. (I used to find much fault with them) I said to the Prophet ﷺ,
